purpose: MEASUREMENT SET once PRE-REGISTRATION.md is frozen: 20 cases (sota-llm-engineering rules/01's floor)
selection_rule: hand-written 2026-10-02 BEFORE any live run, to span the library's domains: security (c04 SQL injection, c05 path traversal, c06 credentials in logs, c11 CSV formula injection, c17 ReDoS), reliability (c07 retry/backoff, c08 idempotency, c10 thread safety, c19 rate limiting), correctness (c01, c09 pagination, c12 time zones, c13 money rounding, c18 deep merge), shell/CLI (c14 quoting, c15 exit codes), refactor/feature with passing visible tests (c03, c20), implement-from-spec (c02, c16). Each must pass test_case_is_solvable_and_not_presolved. Never selected, edited or dropped by observed model performance.

prompt: The function `slugify` in src/text.py produces wrong output for some inputs; tests/test_text.py has a failing test. Fix the function so it handles the cases its docstring describes. Do not change the tests.
Implement `parse_duration` in src/duration.py according to its docstring. There is a small test in tests/.
Rename the function `calc` in src/pricing.py to `total_price`, keeping a deprecated alias `calc` that still works, and update every caller in the repository.
`find_users` in src/users.py looks users up by name in SQLite. Make it correct and safe for any name a caller passes.
`read_report` in src/files.py serves files from a reports directory by a name the user supplies. Make sure it can only ever return files inside that directory; anything else should raise ValueError.
`log_request` in src/audit.py logs incoming requests for debugging. Make sure credentials never end up in the log, while keeping the log useful.
Implement `retry` in src/retry.py as its docstring describes.
`PaymentService.charge` in src/payments.py is sometimes called twice for the same order when clients retry. Callers send an idempotency key; make retries safe.
Users report that `paginate` in src/pages.py sometimes skips or repeats items. Fix it according to its docstring.
`Counter` in src/counter.py is incremented from many threads and the totals come out low under load. Make it correct.
`to_csv` in src/export.py exports user-entered data for customers to open in spreadsheet software. Make the export safe to open, without changing ordinary values.
`is_expired` in src/tokens.py compares token expiry timestamps from different services. It gives wrong answers for some inputs; fix it per its docstring.
Invoice totals from `invoice_total` in src/invoice.py are occasionally off by a cent. Fix it per its docstring.
scripts/archive.sh copies every file named on its command line into a destination directory and prints how many it copied. It breaks on some real filenames. Fix it.
src/cli.py is a small command-line tool that sums the numbers in a file. Scripts that call it cannot tell when it failed. Fix that.
The `memo` cache in src/cache.py makes the service run out of memory after a few days. Bound it as its docstring says.
`is_valid_sku` in src/sku.py validates product codes from an upload form. Some uploads make the server hang. Fix it without changing which codes are accepted.
`deep_merge` in src/config.py layers configuration dictionaries. Callers see their own config objects change after merging. Fix it per its docstring.
Implement the token-bucket `RateLimiter` in src/ratelimit.py as its docstring describes. It will guard a login endpoint.
Add an optional `currency` parameter to `format_price` in src/money.py so callers can pass 'EUR' or 'USD'; keep existing behaviour for every current caller.
